result.summary: The mission and values framing changed: the 'Mission & Values' heading became 'Our Mission' ('Helping People Live Healthier Lives and Helping Make the Health System Work Better for Everyone'), 'change the face of health care' was replaced by 'modern, high-performing health system', and governance was reframed with access and affordability, plus a new emphasis on health equity, which moved from a 'Health Equity' section to a 'Spotlight' feature.
